title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement



At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.

Andela provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to factors including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy (including breastfeeding), genetic information, HIV/AIDS or any other medical status, family or parental status, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement



At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade e organização
  • Experiência em vendas de Serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas SaaS B2B
  • Experiência em Prospecção Ativa em diversos canais 
  • Atuação prévia com vendas Outbound


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologia de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com gestão do tempo;
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas digitais (planilhas, e-mail, CRM etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto de segunda à sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Comissionamento
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de uma empresa em forte expansão.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com grande potencial de aprendizado.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Analista de Projetos Contratos de Obras Sr
description:
Você quer participar da transformação do saneamento no Brasil? Buscamos pessoas que, assim como nós, têm vontade de ir além do básico para aplicar seus conhecimentos em um setor que está mudando a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras. Na BRK, respeito, diversidade e inclusão são valores inegociáveis! Atuamos para promover um ambiente positivo, inovador, ético, inclusivo, seguro e de respeito às pessoas.

Se você sempre quis trabalhar com propósito, temos uma oportunidade que pode te interessar:


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Apoiar o planejamento, desenvolvimento e controle de projetos de investimentos e obras, atuando de forma autônoma e sob supervisão, visando acompanhar o portfólio de projetos e suportar o alcance das metas dos projetos e do negócio.
  • Garantir a eficiência dos projetos, por meio do controle do progresso físico-financeiro, elaborando orçamentos, analisando relatórios de acompanhamento e sugerindo soluções, visando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Assegurar a aderência da carteira de projetos aos respectivos cronogramas físico-financeiros, de acordo com as diretrizes estabelecidas.
  • Assegurar a acuracidade dos dados utilizados na etapa de planejamento, mediante a análise de indicadores técnicos, controle e consolidação dos resultados.
  • Acompanhar indicadores, bem como preparar relatórios e apresentações.


Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica e/ou Automação
  • MS Project
  • Pacote Office Avançado
  • CNH B
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Sumaré SP


O que oferecemos:


Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Vale Refeição ou Alimentação, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Vale Transporte, Programa de Apoio à Saúde, Gympass, DayOff, Licença Maternidade ou Paternidade estendida, PLR; + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo.


A BRK é uma das maiores empresas privadas de saneamento do país e está presente em 13 estados e mais de 100 municípios, beneficiando a vida de mais de 16 milhões de pessoas. Investimos e operamos sistemas de água e esgoto, fornecendo um serviço que faz toda a diferença para a saúde e o bem-estar da população.


A BRK e seus acionistas estão comprometidos com um modelo de gestão ESG (da sigla em inglês para Meio Ambiente, Social e Governança), incorporando esta estratégia à tomada de decisões da companhia e à prestação de serviços.

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade e organização
  • Experiência em vendas de Serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas SaaS B2B
  • Experiência em Prospecção Ativa em diversos canais 
  • Atuação prévia com vendas Outbound


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologia de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com gestão do tempo;
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas digitais (planilhas, e-mail, CRM etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto de segunda à sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Comissionamento
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de uma empresa em forte expansão.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com grande potencial de aprendizado.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Gerente de Projetos Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

title: Coordenador de Operações
description:
Venha fazer parte da 3ª melhor empresa para se trabalhar em Minas Gerais!


A iGreen Energy  foi reconhecida pelo Great Place To Work  como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no estado, graças à nossa cultura organizacional forte, ao respeito pelas pessoas e ao alto nível de engajamento dos nossos colaboradores.


Junte-se a nós e descubra o que torna essa experiência única!



Missão do Cargo: Responsável pela gestão de pessoas e processos do time de operações de créditos de energia em GD. Deve garantir a execução com excelência dos processos de rateio de energia, faturamento dos clientes, comissionamento dos parceiros e pagamento dos geradores de energia sob sua gestão. Como cargo de liderança, deve prezar pelo bom clima organizacional, desenvolver e treinar colaboradores e manter um time engajado e de elevada performance.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar e coordenar a performance operacional do time de operações GD visando o desenvolvimento dos colaboradores e melhoria do clima organizacional.
  • Coordenar a execução das atividades da área de acordo com os objetivos e metas estabelecidas pela liderança, distribuindo, orientando e acompanhando o cumprimento das tarefas dos subordinados, assegurando seu alinhamento com os processos, padrões de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
  • Responder tecnicamente pelo resultado do time de operações, acompanhando potenciais alavancas ou riscos do negócio por uma visão macro dos KPIs e processos.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com áreas de atendimento, comercial e TI visando a construção única de um produto de assinatura solar sustentável.
  • Representar a iGreen e os consórcios de energia perante as distribuidoras em negociações, mudanças de procedimento e eventuais necessidades de refaturamentos.
  • Conduzir todo o processo de expansão da iGreen para outros estados, através de análises tarifárias, avaliação de carteira e necessidades de adequação das ferramentas de TI.
  • Selecionar, desenvolver e treinar novos e atuais colaboradores sob gestão garantindo alta performance e potenciais sucessores
  • Garantir a implantação das melhores práticas de mercado ao que tange o universo da geração compartilhada bem como toda e qualquer mudança regulatória que impacte o negócio de geração distribuída
  • Participar ativamente em projetos estratégicos da empresa que envolvam os processos associados ao time de operações 


Requisitos:

  • De 5 a 7 anos de experiência na área.
  • Graduado e pós-graduado (Engenharia, Administração e áreas relacionadas)
  • Inglês Intermediário.
  • Excel avançado
  • Power Point avançado
  • Domínio do conhecimento em Estrutura tarifária das distribuidoras de energia
  • Regulação do setor elétrico
  • Análise de dados avançado
  • Domínio de regras e normas do mercado de geração distribuída.


Salário: A combinar.

Modelo: 100% Presencial.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (8+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

description:

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors?
